{{Codex|With pinpoint accuracy, the Grinlok lever-action repeating rifle can easily find the soft spot on any target.}}

The '''Grinlok''' is a {{Faction|Grineer}} lever-action rifle crafted from the [[Research|Chem lab]] via clan research. By nature, the Grinlok sports high damage with accurate delivery, supported by its high critical damage and very high [[status chance]], but its extremely low fire rate and small magazine size hampers its ability to manage crowds of enemies.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Impact}} damage.
*Innate {{Pol|Madurai}} polarity.
*Can equip the Grinlok-exclusive {{M|Deadly Sequence}} and {{M|Grinloked}} ([[Conclave]] only) mods.

{{Advantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Semi-Auto|
*Tied with {{Weapon|Prisma Grinlok}} for the second highest base damage of all semi-automatic rifles, behind {{Weapon|Kuva Chakkhurr}}.
*Second highest [[status chance]] of all semi-automatic rifles, behind {{Weapon|Nagantaka}}.
*Little to no vertical [[recoil]].
*Very small spread.
*Excellent ammo efficiency.
}}

{{Disadvantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Semi-Auto|
*Tied with {{Weapon|Prisma Grinlok}} for the second slowest [[fire rate]] of all semi-automatic rifles, after {{Weapon|Kuva Chakkhurr}}.
*Tied with {{Weapon|Nagantaka}} for the lowest magazine size of all semi-automatic rifles.
}}

{{WeaponComparison|Prisma Grinlok}}

==Acquisition==
The Grinlok's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Chem Lab|Chem Lab]] in the [[dojo]].
{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}
This weapon can be sold for {{cc|7,500}}.

==Notes==
*The Grinlok often ragdolls enemies on lethal shots, a side effect of it dealing mainly {{D|Impact}} damage.
*The Grinlok's focus on both {{D|Impact}} and {{D|Slash}} damage makes it generally effective against the [[Grineer]] and the [[Infested]], respectively.

==Tips==
*While the Grinlok is similar to the {{Weapon|Latron}}, it comes with a lower magazine capacity and slower rate of fire, making it more punishing for missed shots. Focus on aiming at heads or weak spots.
*{{M|Shred}} is an excellent mod to help the Grinlok with crowd control, as it increases its slow rate of fire while piercing through groups of enemies, letting each shot deal its massive damage to multiple targets.

==Trivia==
*The News tab in the UI mistakenly referred to this gun as Grinlo'''c'''k.
*The weapon's name may be a combination/corruption of "Grineer" and "[[wikipedia:Flintlock|Flintlock]]", the latter of which was an early firing mechanism in guns used in the 17th, 18th, and 19th centuries.
**Despite the unusual combination of technologies mentioned, a lever-action flintlock rifle did exist [[wikipedia:Cookson repeater|in real life]].
*While {{Weapon|Marelok}} is, theoretically, a sawn-off pistol version of this rifle, its magazine is curiously relocated.

The '''Gorgon Wraith''' is the [[Wraith]] variant of the {{Weapon|Gorgon}}, featuring a slight increase in damage, accuracy, fire rate, status chance, and magazine size, at the cost of critical rate.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Impact}} damage.
*Has a short wind-up time of '''6 rounds''' to reach optimal firing rate.
**Fire rate starts at '''20%''' of the listed value, and increases by '''16%''' per shot.
*Can use the Gorgon-exclusive {{M|Metamorphic Magazine}} mod.
*Can use the Gorgon-exclusive mod {{M|Gorgon Frenzy}} ([[Conclave]] only).

{{Advantages|name=Gorgon Wraith|class=Rifle|trigger=Auto-Spool|}}

{{Disadvantages|name=Gorgon Wraith|class=Rifle|trigger=Auto-Spool|
* Spool-up creates a warm-up period of weakness for fire rate, making short engagements undesirable.
}}

{{WeaponComparison|Gorgon}}
{{WeaponComparison|Prisma Gorgon|header=n}}
{{Acquisition|The blueprint and parts drop from the [[Razorback]] [[Assassination]] [[Alert]]. All parts can be [[Trade System|traded]], although players must have attained [[Mastery Rank]] 7 to acquire the blueprint.}}{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}
This weapon can be sold for {{cc|7,500}}.

==Incarnon Genesis==
*Upon completion of [[The Duviri Paradox]] and [[Angels of the Zariman]], and unlocking [[The Steel Path]], players can earn {{Resource|Gorgon Incarnon Genesis}} from [[The Circuit]]'s Steel Path to place on their Gorgon with the help of [[Cavalero]] in the [[Chrysalith]]. This [[Incarnon Genesis]] form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
**Alternatively, the Gorgon Incarnon Genesis can be bought from Cavalero for {{pc|120}}, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made '''once'''.

====Evolution====
{{Transclude|Gorgon Incarnon Genesis#Evolutions}}

==Tips==
*After the spool-up time, it is possible to use the Gorgon in quick short bursts, allowing you to keep up the high rate of fire, but with less recoil and less bullets wasted, making the Gorgon usable at medium to medium-long ranges.
*You can retain the "charge" of the fire rate by sprinting. This way the weapon stops shooting, but as long as you keep {{Keybind|LMB}} held down, the fire rate will not reset and the weapon will resume fast firing once you stop sprinting.
*Use the {{M|Rifle Ammo Mutation}} mod or the [[Carrier]] Sentinel equipped with {{M|Ammo Case}} to compensate for lost ammo due to the weapon's high rate of fire consuming ammunition on full spool.
*{{M|Speed Trigger}} decreases the charge time considerably, though the increased maximum fire rate causes the weapon to burn through ammo reserves extremely quickly and cause more misses as the recoil throws bullets out more. Consider firing in bursts.

==Trivia==
*The Gorgon Wraith was first introduced during the [[Tethra's Doom]] event, awarded for scoring 500+ points in a [[hijack]] mission, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed [[Orokin Catalyst]].
*The Gorgon Wraith was awarded again from an [[alert]] in the [[Infested Nightmares Bonus Weekend]], once again with a free weapon slot, but did not come with a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.
*On May 9, 2017, {{ver|20.4.4}} and {{ver|20.4.5}}, a bug allowed Gorgon Wraith parts to drop from [[Jackal]]. This was a very short-lived bug, but dissemination of information on the forum allowed many users to learn of and exploit this bug before DE quickly corrected it. The parts and weapon were not removed from users' inventories.
*The Gorgon Wraith is the second Primary Wraith weapon ever released, following the {{Weapon|Strun Wraith}}.
*The Gorgon Wraith only has an upgrade in stats and comes with no default polarities.
*The Gorgon Wraith can use both the Desert Tactics skin and the Day of the Dead skin.

{{Codex|Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.}}

The '''Glaxion''' is a {{Faction|Corpus}} freeze ray which is the first primary weapon to feature {{D|Cold}} as its main damage type.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals {{D|Cold}} damage.
*Can use the Glaxion-exclusive {{M|Photon Overcharge}} mod.

{{Advantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Held|
*Pinpoint [[accuracy]].
**{{M|Heavy Caliber}}'s accuracy penalty is minimal on this weapon.
*Consumes 0.5 ammo per tick of damage.
}}

{{Disadvantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Held|
*Damage ramps up from 20% to 100% over 0.6 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 20% over 2 seconds.
*Limited range of 24 meters.
}}

{{WeaponComparison|Glaxion Vandal}}
{{WeaponComparison|Tenet Glaxion}}

==Acquisition==
The Glaxion's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Energy Lab|Energy Lab]] in the [[dojo]].

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}
This weapon can be sold for {{cc|7,500}}.

==Notes==
*The Glaxion is capable of freezing enemies solid with sustained fire if it kills them. Enemies will progressively turn icy blue (spreading from the point of contact), and eventually become completely solid upon death. Frozen enemies can then be shattered by other attacks. This only applies to normal enemies such as [[Lancer]]s, [[Crewmen]], and [[MOA]]s - Ospreys will simply explode upon death.
**Even if the weapon is modified to have a non-{{D|Cold}} damage type (such as {{D|Blast}} damage), the Glaxion will still freeze foes solid if it kills them.
**Amusingly, it can freeze enemies with {{D|Heat}} damage effects upon death, this effect is merely visual.
**Whether or not they display frozen visuals, enemies killed by the Glaxion create two corpses due to the "shatter" death animation (though the extra corpse may not be visible.)
*When combining elemental mods, the Glaxion's innate {{D|Cold}} damage is added last.
*The weapon requires a fair amount of {{Resource|Cryotic}}, obtained from [[Excavation]] missions, to build. This is probably due to the fact that the weapon fires an icy beam, with the Cryotic possibly fueling its ammunition.

==Tips==
*Enemies that are frozen solid will take at least 1 hit of damage from any source to be destroyed regardless on how much damage it is dealt. This can block powerful enemy projectiles such as [[Napalm]] and [[Bombard]] shots.
**Frozen corpses remain solid for 3 seconds before deteriorating which takes 5 seconds.
**Some enemy abilities still remain in effect while deteriorating such as a [[Nullifier Crewman]]'s bubble, which will start to grow back while deteriorating.

==Trivia==
*The Glaxion is the first weapon to deal pure {{D|Cold}} damage.
*Concept art for the Glaxion was first seen in [[Devstream 22]] alongside concepts for what would eventually become the {{Weapon|Grinlok}}, {{Weapon|Marelok}}, and {{Weapon|Attica}}.
*The revolver-style cartridges on the Glaxion's body spin during firing, though the magazine is the small (battery) box behind the trigger
**Additionally, the Glaxion's barrel telescopes back and forth rapidly during firing, and collapses inward when holstered.
*Enemies who die by the weapon are frozen solid, much like Frost's {{A|Avalanche}} ability, and shatter when hit by any weapon. This effect persists even if the Glaxion's Cold damage has been changed into another element.
**If frozen bodies are left alone for five seconds, the ice will thaw into nothingness.
*Glaxion appears to be a combination of Glac from latin glacies meaning ice and the -(c)tion/-xion suffix denoting a process. Effectively resulting in "turning to ice" or "freezing".
*Glaxion bears similarity to the French word ''[[wiktionary:Glaçon|glaçon]]'', meaning "ice cube" or "icicle".
*[[Corpus Target]]s sometimes use this weapon, along with a {{A|Snow Globe}} shield from Arctic [[Eximus]] enemies.
*The Glaxion's energy-syphoning beam is visually similar to the Proton Pack's proton stream from the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghostbusters_(franchise) Ghostbusters] film series.
*{{Weapon|Verglas}} is a sentinel version of this weapon with identical stats.

{{Codex|A cutting-edge, halogen-cooled electron accelerator capable of snap-freezing a target in moments.}}

The '''Glaxion Vandal''' is the [[Vandal]] variant of the {{Weapon|Glaxion}} freeze ray rifle, sporting higher damage, [[critical chance]], [[status chance]], magazine size, max ammo reserves, and [[reload speed]]. The Vandal variant also sports a spherical area-of-effect damage at the beam's maximum range or point-of-contact, allowing the gun to hit more than one enemy at the end of its beam stream.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals {{D|Cold}} damage.
*The zone of impact or maximum beam range produces a damaging cold blotch in a spherical radius of '''2''' meters, allowing it to hit multiple enemies at once.
**Can benefit from {{M|Firestorm|Firestorm}} ({{M|Primed Firestorm|Primed}}).
**Not affected by [[multishot]].
**Area of effect does not inflict [[Stagger|self-stagger]] and has no [[Damage Falloff]].
*Kills create an extra corpse, synergizing with {{WF|Nekros}}' {{A|Desecrate}}.
*Can use the Glaxion-exclusive {{M|Photon Overcharge}} mod.

{{Advantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Held|
*Pinpoint [[accuracy]].
**{{M|Heavy Caliber}}'s accuracy penalty is minimal on this weapon.
*Consumes 0.5 ammo per tick of damage.
}}

{{Disadvantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Held|
*Damage ramps up from 30% to 100% over 0.6 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 30% over 2 seconds.
*Area of effect has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions.
*Limited range of 28 meters.
**{{M|Sinister Reach}} can be equipped to extend the maximum range.
}}

{{WeaponComparison|Glaxion}}
{{WeaponComparison|Tenet Glaxion}}

==Acquisition==
The weapon is periodically sold by [[Baro Ki'Teer]] in the Concourse section of the [[Tenno]] [[Relay]] for {{cc|250,000}} and {{dc|475}}. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

The weapon can be [[Trade System|traded]], but only when unranked and without [[Forma]] or an [[Orokin Catalyst]] installed. The trading recipient must also have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 12.

===History===
This weapon was awarded for earning 4,000 points in a single Endurance [[Disruption]] Mission in [[Operation: Hostile Mergers]], complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed [[Orokin Catalyst]].

Was re-obtainable by watching a livestream from any channel in [https://www.warframe.com/news/warframe-at-the-game-awards The Game Awards] directory with a [https://www.warframe.com/twitch/link Twitch-linked account] for 30 consecutive minutes on December 12, 2019.

Drop was re-deployed by watching [https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1155240-thanks-for-watching-prime-time-273/ Prime Time episode 273] with a Twitch-linked account for 30 consecutive minutes on December 19, 2019.

==Notes==
*The zone of impact or maximum beam range creates a spherical area of effect of 2 meters, dealing the weapon's full damage (i.e. there is no damage falloff).
**The range of the area of effect is unaffected by {{M|Sinister Reach}}.
**[[Punch Through]] affects the location of the weapon's area of effect. The weapon's area of effect is applied at the ''final point'' of contact rather than whenever an enemy is struck.
*The Glaxion Vandal is capable of freezing enemies solid with sustained fire if it kills them. Enemies will progressively turn icy blue (spreading from the point of contact), and eventually become completely solid upon death. Frozen enemies can then be shattered by other attacks. This only applies to normal enemies such as [[Lancer]]s, [[Crewmen]], and [[MOA]]s—Ospreys will simply explode upon death.
**Even if the weapon is modified to have a non-{{D|Cold}} damage type (such as {{D|Blast}} damage), the Glaxion will still freeze foes solid if it kills them.
**Amusingly, it can freeze enemies with {{D|Heat}} damage effects upon death; this effect is merely visual.
**Whether or not they display frozen visuals, enemies killed by the Glaxion create two corpses due to the "shatter" death animation (though the extra corpse may not be visible).
*When combining elemental mods, the Glaxion's innate {{D|Cold}} damage is added last.

==Tips==
*Enemies that are frozen solid will take at least 1 hit from any source to be destroyed regardless of how much damage it is dealt. This can block powerful enemy projectiles such as [[Napalm]] and [[Bombard]] shots.
**Frozen corpses remain solid for 3 seconds before deteriorating which takes 5 seconds.
**Some enemy abilities still remain in effect while deteriorating such as a [[Nullifier Crewman]]'s bubble, which will start to grow back while deteriorating.
*Because the beam can generate a damaging AoE at impact or at its max range, the Glaxion Vandal can become a deceptively effective crowd controller without the need for loading Punch Through - especially considering its ability to slow a group of enemies with {{D|Cold}} procs to give ample space for players to finish them off.

==Trivia==
*The Glaxion Vandal is the fifth weapon to deal pure {{D|Cold}} damage, after the original Glaxion, the {{Weapon|Sibear}} hammer (prior to [[Update 26]]), and the {{Weapon|Artax}} and {{Weapon|Cryotra}} [[Sentinel]] weapons.
*The Glaxion Vandal is the first Vandal variant that has a unique distinguishing feature to its standard counterpart instead of merely having direct stat changes (in this case, the spherical AoE at the beam's maximum reach).
**These altered features of standard weapons have been previously exclusive to their [[Prime Weapons|Primed]], [[Kuva Weapons|Kuva]] and [[Tenet Weapons|Tenet]] variants.
*The revolver-style cartridges on the Glaxion's body spin during firing, though the magazine is the small (battery) box behind the trigger.
**Additionally, the Glaxion's barrel telescopes back and forth rapidly during firing and collapses inward when holstered.
**The beam itself will oscillate slightly. This does not seem to affect the accuracy or hit registration in any way.
*Enemies who die by the weapon are frozen solid, much like Frost's {{A|Avalanche}} ability, and shatter when hit by any weapon. This effect persists even if the Glaxion's Cold damage has been changed into another element.
**If frozen bodies are left alone for five seconds, the ice will thaw into nothingness.
*Glaxion bears similarity to the French word ''[[wiktionary:Glaçon|glaçon]]'', meaning "ice cube" or "icicle".

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|32}}
;Headshot Damage Changes

During playtesting, the ammo changes alone weren’t enough to significantly change things for AoE weapons. So instead of tightening these values to be overly restrictive, we chose to address other factors that make these weapons so strong, such as headshot damage.

Our approach here is two-fold, to reduce the impact of headshots for AOE weapons, but to also make precision headshots pack a larger punch overall.

*Radial damage no longer gains extra headshot damage or triggers headshot conditions.
**This is primarily targeted at the Ignis Wraith - as a “flamethrower” weapon, it’s hard to imagine a blanket of elements being precise enough to target weak points specifically. Explosive projectiles themselves can still land headshots, so there is still a reason to aim with most weapons for maximum damage.

{{ver|25.2.3}}

{{ver|25}}

}}

{{Codex|Long before clone-rot set in, elite Grineer Commanders protected the surviving Orokin from rebelling Warframes with these formidable rifles. When Gotva Prime inflicts a Status Effect its next shot has a chance to be a Super Critical hit.}}
'''Gotva Prime''' is a standalone [[Prime]] rifle, widely used by ancient [[Orokin Era]] {{Faction|Grineer}} soldiers during the [[The Collapse|final days of the Empire]]. Fully automatic with pure {{D|Puncture}} damage, [[Status Effect]]s from the Gotva Prime have a chance to set the next shot to 300% [[Critical Chance]].

This weapon can be sold for {{cc|7,500}}.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals pure {{D|Puncture}} damage.
*[[Status Effect]]s have a '''15%'''<ref>[DE]Momaw [https://forums.warframe.com/topic/1365014-echoes-of-duviri-hotfix-3367/?do=findComment&comment=12861948 confirming on the official Forums] that the exact chance for this to happen is 15%. (2023, August 31) </ref> chance to set the next hit's [[Critical Chance]] to '''300%'''.
**The effect is triggered separately for each bullet when using [[Multishot]], as well as each enemy hit with [[Punch Through]].
***Whether an enemy hit via Punch Through can be subject to the increased crit chance depends on whether or not the previous enemy hit was inflicted with a status effect, not whether the previous shot did.
** Applying multiple status effects in a single hit does '''not''' increase the chance for the effect.
**Chance remains until landing another successful shot; missed shots will not reset the chance.
**Set Critical Chance ignores all other modifiers, whether from mods or Warframe abilities. However, the [[Vigilante Set|Vigilante set mods]] can increase the damage to that of a Tier-4 critical hit.

==Acquisition==
Gotva Prime is potentially sold by [[Baro Ki'Teer]] in the Concourse section of the [[Tenno]] [[Relay]] for {{cc|625,000}} and {{dc|675}}. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.

The weapon can be [[Trade System|traded]], but only when unranked and without [[Forma]] or [[Orokin Catalyst]] installed. The trading recipient must also have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 14.

===History===
Gotva Prime was acquired by watching [[TennoCon/2023|TennoCon 2023]] on [https://twitch.tv/warframe WARFRAME's Twitch] with a [https://www.warframe.com/twitch/link Twitch-linked account] for 30 consecutive minutes, between 12:30 p.m. and 5:00 p.m. ET, on August 26th, 2023. The drop included a free weapon slot and pre-installed [[Orokin Catalyst]].

==Trivia==
*Artwork for the Gotva Prime was first showcased during [[TennoCon/2019|TennoCon 2019]].<ref>{{Ref|title=TennoCon 2019 - From Concept to Creation: The Art of Warframe|author=PlayWarframe|year=2019|month=7|day=15|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v{{=}}qpTxBqpSUiU&t{{=}}14m27s|access-date=2022-05-01|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220501194746/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qpTxBqpSUiU|archive-date=2022-05-01|youtube-id=qpTxBqpSUiU|channel-name=PlayWarframe|channel-id=UCBIdHvSAyoud-CNZOVKW2-w|extra=Art @ 14:27}}</ref> It was also featured in the [[Awakening]] cinematic cutscene, wielded by [[Orokin Era]] [[Grineer]].
*{{Weapon|Aeolak}} appears to be a [[Void]]-warped version of the Gotva Prime, or of one in a related weapon family, as it differs in mechanics and subtle visual details. The Aeolak is also wielded by [[Thrax Legatus]], which are Void manifestations of ancestral Grineer.
*Gotva Prime is the first non-[[Founders|Founder]] exclusive [[Prime]]d equipment that is not obtained through [[Void Relic]]s.
*Gotva Prime has an unusual reload animation, which appears to involve ejecting and replacing the entire barrel. This somewhat resembles the magazine of the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heckler_%26_Koch_G11 Heckler & Koch G11], which slots into the front of the gun above the barrel.
**It could also be based on the loading and operation of [[wikipedia:Metal Storm|Metal Storm]] weapons, which have their ammunition pre-loaded into barrels and electronically fired in sequence within the barrels, allowing for extremely fast bursts at the cost of requiring barrels to be swapped to reload. The Gotva Prime's extreme rate of fire and reloading animation involving the barrel being replaced could be based on this.
*Despite having Prime in the name, [[Baro Ki'Teer]] will not interact with the player as he would if you had primes equipped.

Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed Electricity Status.}} The '''Grimoire''' is the prized diary of the prominent {{Faction|Orokin}} scientist, [[Albrecht Entrati]]. It is a unique secondary weapon that casts bolts of {{D|Electricity}}, while its [[Alternate Fire]] throws a large voltaic orb that can slowly travel forward and bounce around the environment, electrocuting any enemies in its path. ==Characteristics== * This weapon deals pure {{D|Electricity}} damage. * Primary fire hurls fully automatic arcane energies. ** Has infinite ammo; does not need to reload. ** Shots explode in a '''1''' meter radius on impact with a surface or enemy. *** Explosions has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from 100% to 20% from central impact. *** Initial hits and explosions apply status separately. *** Explosions do not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls. ** Punch-Through is disabled on the primary fire. * [[Alternate Fire]] summons a voltaic orb that launches electric bolts capable of leaping between enemies, and applying a forced {{D|Electricity}} proc on all targets. Orb attacks '''1''' enemy within '''6''' meters every second with an electric bolt that then chains to an additional '''2''' enemies within '''6''' meters of the bolt's target. ** The bolt and the chained hits both count as "Alt-Fire hits" for [[Tome Mods|Invocation]] mods like {{M|Vome Invocation|Vome}} and {{M|Netra Invocation|Netra}}, and both can hit [[weakspot]]s. ** Each chain hit does the same amount of damage as the initial electric bolt. Each attack makes an individual roll for status and critical chance. *** Despite being listed as having 350 base damage, the alt-fire's actual in-game base damage value is 280. Other base damage values are accurate. ** Number of chains is affected by [[Multishot]]. Rather than rolling a chance for an additional shot, Multishot here functions in steps. The number of chain hits increases by 1 for every 33.3% of Multishot added. *** For example, a maxed {{M|Amalgam Barrel Diffusion}} and {{M|Lethal Torrent}} would add 170% Multishot, and launch an orb which strikes an enemy, and then chains an additional 7 times. With at least 234% added Multishot, {{M|Xata Invocation}} can be maxed out with 10 stacks by a single bolt and its 9 subsequent chain hits. ** Chain seek radius is centered on the most recent target, and updates between chain hits, allowing for an orb with a high multishot value to leap to enemies well beyond the visually indicated 6m range. * Alt-Fire requires a fully filled meter beneath the reticle in order to fire. The meter takes '''45''' seconds to completely recharge. Hitting enemies with the primary fire reduces recharge time by '''1''' second per hit. ** Multishot hits restore charge meter. ** Picking up secondary or universal ammo while Grimoire is held reduces recharge time by '''10''' seconds. Ammo pickups from {{M|Pistol Ammo Mutation}} do not reduce recharge time. ** Radial damage, [[Extra Hit]] mechanics, and attacks from specters do not restore charge meter. * Base projectile speed is a fairly slow 6.0 m/s and can be increased with {{M|Lethal Momentum}}. * The rate of bolt attacks from the voltaic orb is '''not''' affected by [[Fire Rate]]. ** Fire rate increases the speed of animation that creates the voltaic orb. * The "active radial attack" refers to the explosion at the end of the voltaic orb's duration, which has linear [[Damage Falloff]] from '''100%''' to '''20%''' from central impact. ** The orb's electric bolt and its chaining hits are not affected by damage falloff or by {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}). ==Acquisition== This weapon is acquired during the [[Whispers in the Walls]] quest at max rank with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed [[Orokin Catalyst]]. Additional copies can be built afterward; the blueprint is sold by [[Bird 3]] of {{Faction|Cavia}} for {{sc|50,000}} and requires '''Rank 4 - Scholar'''. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} ==Notes== * The Grimoire can use a unique set of [[mod]]s called [[Tome Mods]] in addition to standard Secondary Weapon mods. * Some weapon stats, including modded damage and multishot, are updated dynamically for already-launched voltaic orbs (i.e., benefits from {{Arcane|Conjunction Voltage}} and {{Arcane|Arcane Precision}} stacks created after it was launched). ** Other weapon stats, including crit chance, are [[Snapshotting|snapshotted]] at time of using Alt-Fire. ** The stats are then inherited by the bolt attack and its chain hits, allowing for {{Arcane|Secondary Enervate}} to apply for the full duration of an orb, as well as buffs like {{Arcane|Secondary Surge}}, {{A|Ballistic Battery}}, and {{M|Galvanized Crosshairs}} to apply if they were active at the time of firing. * Voltaic orbs do not need line of sight on their targets, and can launch electric bolts at enemies that are behind walls. ** However, the orb itself bounces when it hits level geometry, while slowing nearly to a halt. This can be useful for keeping it in range of a stationary target. * When a voltaic orb hits a Nullifier bubble, it is not destroyed. The orb just bounces off the bubble, and cannot target enemies inside of it. * The voltaic orb will target invulnerable enemies, and hits on invulnerable enemies will stack Invocation effects. ** Orb will not target enemies in a 'defeated' state (ex: kneeling Adversaries and Thrall enemies), nor damageable allies (ex: those created by {{A|Enthrall}}. ** Alt-fire meter is charged when attacking damageable allies, but not invulnerable or defeated enemies. * Enemies with Overguard will still be struck by the voltaic orb and targeted by chain lightning. * The alt-fire orb technically fires new shots (similar to {{Weapon|Azima}} alt-fire). This bypasses single-hit rules that normally apply to all projectiles guided by {{A|Navigator}}. * Although the weapon can proc headshots, that is mostly from the {{D|Electricity}} procs rather than the the chain hits, which seem to leap between the centers of enemy hitboxes. * Because all of the procs from chain hits happen simultaneously, has limited synergy with {{Arcane|Secondary Encumber}}, as only 1 extra proc can occur per tick. * Alt-Fire and the radial effect of the primary attack do not receive any damage bonus from {{M|Galvanized Shot}}. * Cannot be equipped by [[On Call Crew]]. * The Alt-Fire voltaic orb disappears when casting {{A|Razorwing}} or when switching between {{WF|Sirius & Orion}}. ** On casting {{A|Reroot}}, the orb does not disappear, and can activate Invocation mods while Nokko is hidden, appearing on-screen after Reroot ends. * The uncontrolled frame of {{WF|Sirius & Orion}} can use the Grimoire, but their kills will not activate Canticle mods, and they seem not to cast Alt-Fire. * Tome mod buffs do not have any interaction with {{Arcane|Secondary Kinship}}. ==Tips== * With infinite ammo and no reload, the Grimoire can benefit greatly from [[Fire Rate]] mods to increase damage output. * [[Multishot]] significantly helps charging alternate fire meter, as individual projectile hits contribute toward charging it. * {{M|Lethal Momentum}} increases the speed of both primary and Alt-Fire projectiles. ** To avoid overshooting enemies with the Alt-Fire, aim the orb at a surface near them. When it bounces, it will lose almost all momentum, creating a nearly stationary area of effect, which can help charge up [[Tome Mods|Invocation]] mods. * Due to its pure {{D|Electricity}} base damage, the orb can offer crowd control by efficiently applying {{D|Radiation}} to large groups of enemies. * Quickly dropping an Alt-Fire orb with {{Arcane|Secondary Fortifier}} on a group of enemies with Eximus units mixed in grants continuous Overguard gain, while allowing the wielder to perform other actions. ==Bugs== * Base damage of the alt-fire mode is listed as 350, but is actually 280. * Neither fire mode seems to work properly with {{M|Galvanized Shot}}. ** The main projectile of the primary fire mode works at the expected value, but the radial effect is not affected at all. ** Alt-Fire mode does not apply Galvanized Shot on the electric bolt or chain hits. ==Lore & History== === Albrecht's Notes === {{Main|Fragments/Albrecht}} After Albrecht's pilgrimage into the Wall of Lohk, he began documenting important events and details of his research. The pages of his Grimoire soon became full of records detailing the {{Faction|Cavia}} experimentations, Albrecht's journey to [[Duviri]], and the purpose behind the '''[[Vessels]]'''.{{CustomCollapsible|Albrecht's Notes|Albrecht's_Laboratories}} {{Fragments |fragment = The Aftermath |image = |planet = [[Albrecht's Laboratories]] |scans = 6 |loretext = I wanted nothing but the ease of oblivion, at first. I floated ignorant in baths of nepenthe, a second gestation. Unseeing, unspeaking. Only rarely did my brain flicker errant light across the cave-paintings still smeared on the interior of my skull. At sensation's edge I knew a vague silhouette of Loid crooning motherly across the watery distances, the poetry my tongue was too blackened to recite. ---- Too craven to chase death, I awaited it. The father of fears, and yet I was still afraid. The currents whispered coward. I clenched my body into a fist as a foetus must and blinded myself afresh. Stark pain smoked the juice of my living tomb. Why did the saga not end by itself? Why must I still act? ---- Steeped in solitude, I found I could no longer endure my own company. Disgust did the work of courage. I tore the mundane membrane, slid weak and mucosal into Loid's embrace. ---- Loid nursed me then, tending first to the uprooted ruin of my eyes, then to the mouth whose grin no longer hid behind flesh. The agony bit deep, but it was clean. Blameless love bled up from me. I had decided to live. ---- I felt no certainty as I donned clothes rough and strange to the touch of newgrown skin. I had none of the selfless zeal of the soldier. The same cursed question still pursued me as it had before: was I, even now, trapped in the rictus of the Wall? ---- The apparatus of logic would never yield an answer. Only resolute action remained. If I must be a demon, let me be an honest one. Let me prove my nature by what I do next. Purpose. Let me leave such blazing footprints behind me as no unclean thing would dare to walk in. |narrator=Albrecht |hiddentext = }} {{Fragments |fragment = The Cavia |image = |planet = [[Albrecht's Laboratories]] |scans = 6 |loretext = I employed a variety of Cavia in an attempt to unmake the adversary. The principle was straightforward enough, though in hindsight I abhor my naivete. My humanity had been unscrolled by the caustic Void and now smirked back at me across the divide, privy to all my unfettered malice and pettiness. In answer, I resolved to hurl into the Void minds that were not human. Let it parody them. The proximity of the bestial would force a humbling devolution, or so I thought. ---- The majority of the Cavia merely died. I gave the Void living beings and it sent me back bedraggled cadavers. The dead lay stacked in pyramids around my deserted lab. I was nothing but a failed priest. But a glass splinter of stubbornness still stuck in me. And so, I persisted. The correct combination of creatures would work. ---- I realized my error as I sweated by visionary nestawood cinders, beside Loid who curled pale and sick from chewing too much of the root. The catalyst was uniqueness. That attribute was what caught the interest of the bland and undifferentiated Void. It was not necessary to explore queasy debates about the Oro; animal minds simply lacked the full distinction of a singular persona. My Kalymos, I was sure, was an exception, but I would not sacrifice that loyal being. Perhaps I should have. The sin I was to commit was worse. ---- The very last breeding pair of Cervulites was smuggled to me, causing Loid no small inconvenience. A species on the brink of extinction. Here was the uniqueness the Void sought. I was certain to the pit of my entrails. I loaded the pair on their Seriglass bridal barge, along with an expendable avian and a Norg for mental ballast. Fish, fowl and beast. A facile equilibrium. ---- They did not die, save one. They came back changed. Witnesses. Piligrims, even, chanting freakish praise to the one beyond the wall. I knew, then, that my gambit had lost. So long as I worked through scapegoats, my guilt would only deepen. I must atone for what I had done through my own blood. ---- Standard laboratory hygiene would have been to dispose of them. But some instinct stayed my hand. The Voidtongue was an enigma to me, but another - more habituated to the Void than I - might one day unravel it. Through the imposition of form upon the formless they could, perhaps, glean some meaning. I assigned the Cavia to Loid, for I could not bear to look upon them. Not yet. Loid is, at heart, a good and kind man - better than I deserve. And completely oblivious to his own true worth. |narrator=Albrecht |hiddentext = }} {{Fragments |fragment = Duviri |image = |planet = [[Albrecht's Laboratories]] |scans = 5 |loretext = In Duviri, I woke every day to the voice of my daughter. I recoiled from this at first, feeling the sting of conscience. I could not confront, even in semblance, the woman I had abandoned. Instead I reinvented myself as a teacher, advising the child-King of the menace beyond his borders. But as the days melted away, I came to recognize the strange cast of characters Euleria had created, and their purpose. I heard voices I had myself first conjured in the darkness of her childhood chambers, for no other reward than her delight. She had not only preserved this gift I had thought so trivial, she had made it an instrument of healing. More: a stronghold. ---- Despite my legacy of neglect, despite my shoddy example, my needs, my demands, my daughter had triumphed in my absence. Her confidence, her warmth, shamed me. I had fled from the horror, but she? She had stood alongside the most vulnerable, those with the most to lose, and told them a different story. ---- I did not perceive the significance of Euleria's stance at first. Her concern for the children was not merely pastoral attentiveness. It was a direct strike against the Indifference. She was teaching the weak to be strong in the very places where those cold fingers could reach, and through her act of compassion, spitting in the face of alienation and despair. Could I do less? ---- Shame is an inert state, but fertile. It primes the mind, bolstering it for repentance. I had thought to make a difference in Duviri. But Duviri had made a difference in me. My own daughter's creations, reverberating and growing in the womb of the Void, had shown me another path than that of the indulgent coward. I was neither helpless nor irredeemable. Like she had, I could fight. ---- I took inspiration from Euleria's example. To the people of Duviri I bequeathed a legacy of cautionary stories. In them I spoke of fears that an infinity of spirals would not, could not, erase. I slipped away from those lands, silent and unnoticed. From their joys, their sadnesses. From the celebration in my honor. In her, they already had all they needed. My work, I now understood, must proceed from a different point. I would confront the phantom myself, and deny it to the teeth. |narrator=Albrecht |hiddentext = }} {{Fragments |fragment = The Vessels |image = |planet = [[Albrecht's Laboratories]] |scans = 5 |loretext = I went among the denizens of the plague year like a savior, my hands filled with healing. To those who volunteered, I brought more than health. Their bodies were primed; it needed only the Helminth infusions, brought from my own time, to work the alchemy of transformation. They have become partial Warframes, still in possession of their free will, yet enhanced, Void-attuned, capable. ---- Their humanity may not last. My deliverance may yet consume them, the human swallowed up in the sacred beast. And if my wayward disciples turn on me, what words of comfort shall I have beyond: this is the bargain we have made. Through our sacrifice, history will be saved. ---- As their loyal doctor, I have taken repeated samples from them. The sight of their Technocyte-riddled cells mutating gave me fresh visions. I could take this material, work with it, forge new creations. Eagerly I brought the samples back to Deimos and began to cultivate them. ---- It was Loid who pointed out the singular attributes of the Grey Strain. How it stimulates growth to monstrous dimensions. Many thoughts converged in me then. What if, through precise biochemical engineering, I could create the equivalents of Warframes, yet built to a titanic scale? Surely such a legion could stand against the Adversary... Assuming, of course, that an Operator could be found. ---- Not long after, the first of my Vessels took form. A giant to battle giants, merging the humanity of the man Arthur, the anatomical perfection of Ballas's Warframes, and the titanic potency of the Grey Strain. My saviors. |narrator=Albrecht |hiddentext = }} {{Fragments |fragment = We End As We Began |image = |planet = [[Albrecht's Laboratories]] |scans = 1 |loretext = All is in readiness. Loid will do as he is bid, though his eyes silently plead with me to choose another path. As I await my final crossing to the past, I ponder what role a scientist may play in so spiritual a matter as 'absolution'. How in the alchemy of the soul, even repentance must necessarily be a calculated task. I will repair what I have broken, no more and no less. The scales must balance. And in such a monstrous penitence as this, I shall take no heed of the dust that may fall upon them on either side, the dust of petty lives. The builders of old tempered their mortar with blood, to appease the most ancient of land-spirits. We should have been so wise. Yet it is not too late to learn. The sands fall. The circuit completes. I return to the place of the beginning. Let witless hordes bleat their disdain for every fervent plan;
The deal is done, the die is cast. I end as I began. |narrator=Albrecht |hiddentext = }} {{CustomCollapsible/End}} === Voruna's Continuity === {{Main|Leverian#Voruna}} The Grimoire was first mentioned in {{WF|Voruna}}'s [[Leverian]] exhibit. '''Glory''' is {{WF|Jade}}'s [[Exalted Weapon|Exalted]] Orbitars, summoned by activating the ability {{A|Glory on High}}. Primary fire shoots explosive {{D|Heat}} beams, while its [[Alternate Fire]] detonates [[Jade/Abilities#Passive|Judgments]] in a disintegration blast.
<section end=intro />

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals pure {{D|Heat}} damage.
*Innate two {{Pol|Madurai}} polarities.
*Primary fire shoots explosive projectiles.
**Shots explode in a {{Stat|Ability Range|icon=only}}'''2''' meter radius on impact with a surface or enemy, with '''100%''' [[Damage Falloff|damage falloff]] from the center.
***Affected by {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}).
****Bonus only scales with the base explosion radius, stacking additively with the bonus from ability range.
***Requires [[Line of Sight]] to deal damage.
****[[Line of Sight]] is affected by [[Punch Through]]; Sufficient amounts of Punch Through allows the explosion to deal damage to enemies not within line of sight.
**Shots have a <u>'''10%'''</u> chance to debuff enemies with [[Jade/Abilities#Passive|Judgments]], applying <u>'''50%'''</u> [[Damage Vulnerability]] for <u>'''10'''</u> seconds.
***Debuff chance is unaffected by Status Chance, or any Ability Stats.
*[[Alternate Fire]] detonates Judgments.
**Enemies explode in a {{Stat|Ability Range|icon=only}}'''4''' meter radius.
***Not affected by {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}).
***Enemies standing within {{A|Light's Judgment}} have their explosion radius increased by <u>'''1.5x'''</u>.
***'''Is''' affected by:
****[[Critical Chance]] and [[Critical Damage]]
****[[Elemental Damage]]
****[[Faction Damage Bonus|Faction Damage]]
****[[Status Chance]], [[Status Damage]], and [[Status Duration]]
****{{Arcane|Secondary Enervate}}, {{Arcane|Secondary Encumber}}, {{Arcane|Secondary Fortifier}}, and {{Arcane|Secondary Outburst}}
***Is '''not''' affected by:
****[[Damage#Increasing Base Damage|Base Damage]] ({{M|Hornet Strike}}, {{Arcane|Secondary Merciless}}, {{A|Symphony of Mercy|Deathbringer}}'s weapon damage bonus)
****[[Multishot]]
****[[Fire Rate]]
****[[Reload Speed]]
****{{Arcane|Cascadia Empowered}}, {{Arcane|Secondary Irradiate}}, {{Arcane|Secondary Shiver}}, and {{Arcane|Secondary Surge}}

'''Advantages:'''
*Has infinite ammo and does not need to [[reload]].

'''Disadvantages:'''
*Primary fire has '''100%''' damage falloff, dealing '''0''' damage at the edge of its explosion radius.
*Requires energy to activate and keep active. Alternate Fire uses additional energy to activate.
*{{M|Galvanized Shot}}'s [[Condition Overload (Mechanic)|damage per status type]] has no effect on the explosion.

==Notes==
*Glory uses Pistol Mods.
*Glory appears in the [[Arsenal]] after unlocking Jade's {{A|Glory on High}} ability.
*Explosion radius scales with Glory on High ability rank and is affected by {{Stat|Ability Range}}.
*Is affected by {{M|Amalgam Furax Body Count}}.

{{Codex|Deliver a ruthless barrage of Sentient artillery from this instrument of death. Alt-fire splits the weapon apart into 8 separate rifles, expanding its devastation by tracking up to 4 targets at once, while consuming more ammo per shot.}}
'''Haalvu''' is a {{Faction|Sentient}} multi-barreled rifle. It deals pure {{D|Tau}} damage and its [[Alternate Fire]] transforms the barrels into 8 floating burst-fire rifles that auto-target up to 4 nearby enemies.

==Characteristics==
* This weapon deals {{D|Tau}} damage in both firing modes.
* [[Alternate Fire]] transforms the weapon between full-auto mode and burst modes.
** Burst mode causes the rifle barrels to split apart into miniature rifles that use a '''2''' shot burst-fire. Miniature Rifles target up to '''4''' enemies within '''40°''' of the reticle and within '''10m''' of the player. Miniature Rifles remain locked on to enemies while they are within '''60°''' of the reticle and '''10m''' of the player.
*** Burst mode consumes '''1.5''' ammo per shot ('''3''' ammo per burst) per target.
*** Miniature Rifles targets are indicated by a laser pointer when firing.
** Switching firing modes takes '''3''' seconds to complete and can be interrupted. Mode swapping speed is affected by [[Reload Speed]].
* Does not use ammo pickups; ammo regenerates over time.
** Has a '''0.5''' second delay after the weapon stops firing before regenerating ammo. Then, regenerates '''300''' ammo per second; takes '''0.5''' seconds to regenerate a fully depleted unmodded battery excluding the delay.
** If ammo is fully depleted, the weapon will enter a reload animation of '''2''' seconds. However, it cannot be manually reloaded.
* Innate two {{Pol|Madurai}} polarities.

== Acquisition ==
Haalvu was able to be acquired by watching [[TennoCon/2026|TennoCon 2026]] on [https://twitch.tv/warframe WARFRAME's Twitch] with a [https://www.warframe.com/twitch/link Twitch-linked account] for 30 consecutive minutes, between 11:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. ET (UTC -4), on July 11th, 2026. It comes with a free Weapon [[Slot]] and pre-installed {{Resource|Orokin Catalyst}}.

The Haalvu is expected to be returning with the start of [[Epoch Operation: Taubound]], but the exact method of acquisition is currently unknown.

== Notes ==

* {{WF|Mirage}}'s {{A|Hall of Mirrors}} clones do not fire the homing projectiles in Alternate Fire mode, instead firing Primary Fire projectiles.

== Bugs ==
* Rifles will aim towards the nearest body part of their target, including their weapons, which can cause shots to miss.
* The reload animation is skipped on the burst mode if the player has 5 or more stacks of {{Arcane|Primary Crux}}.

== Trivia ==
* Haalvu is the first player weapon that deals {{D|Tau}} damage.
** {{Weapon|Venato Prime}} can apply {{D|Tau}} status, but only when applying another Status Effect on enemies.
* At the start of the reload animation, a sound similar to the [[Eidolon]] weak point sound plays, followed by a cut version of the [[Teralyst]] spawn sound effect.
